    rcases hKmax with h0 | ⟨cl, hcl, l, hl, hlK⟩
    · refine ⟨0, fun hM => ?_, Nat.zero_le _⟩
      exfalso
      
      have : ∃ cl ∈ f, ∃ l, l ∈ cl := by
        have hsum : 0 < (f.map List.length).sum := hM
        obtain ⟨j, hj, hpos⟩ : ∃ j, ∃ hj : j < f.length, 0 < f[j].length := by
          apply Classical.byContradiction
          intro hno
          have hz : ∀ g : CNF, (∀ cl ∈ g, cl.length = 0) → (g.map List.length).sum = 0 := by
            intro g hg
            induction g with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons cl g ih =>
              simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
              rw [hg cl List.mem_cons_self, ih (fun c hc => hg c (List.mem_cons_of_mem cl hc))]
          have : (f.map List.length).sum = 0 := by
            apply hz
            intro cl hcl
            obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hcl
            apply Classical.byContradiction
            intro hne
            exact hno ⟨j, hj, by omega⟩
          omega
        exact ⟨f[j], List.getElem_mem hj, f[j][0], List.getElem_mem hpos⟩
      obtain ⟨cl, hcl, l, hl⟩ := this
      have := hKlt cl hcl l hl
      omega
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hcl
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hl
      obtain ⟨he, hV, _⟩ := canon_occ_lit f j t hj ht
      exact ⟨pt.O j + t, fun _ => ⟨he, by rw [hV]; exact hlK⟩, Nat.le_of_lt he⟩
  let estar := Classical.choose hest
  have hestar := Classical.choose_spec hest
  
  have hsel : ∀ j (hj : j < f.length), ∃ t, ∃ ht : t < f[j].length,
      evalLiteral a (f[j][t]'ht) = true := by
    intro j hj
    have hc : evalClause a f[j] = true := by
      simp only [evalCNF, List.all_eq_true] at ha
      exact ha f[j] (List.getElem_mem hj)
    simp only [evalClause, List.any_eq_true] at hc
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hle⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hl
    exact ⟨t, ht, hle⟩
  let tsel : Nat → Nat := fun j => if hj : j < f.length then Classical.choose (hsel j hj) else 0
  have htsel : ∀ j (hj : j < f.length), ∃ ht : tsel j < f[j].length,
      evalLiteral a (f[j][tsel j]'ht) = true := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [tsel, hj, dite_true]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hsel j hj)
  
  obtain ⟨et, hn2, hemb, hends, hbnd, hcnt, hzero⟩ :=
    embed_complete encodeEnd decodeEnd decodeEnd_encodeEnd hp
  have hinc_len : (incidenceGraph f).length = pt.M := by
    rw [incidenceGraph_length]; rfl
  have hinc : ∀ e, e < pt.M → (incidenceGraph f)[e]? = some (Sum.inl (pt.V e), Sum.inr (pt.J e)) := by
    intro e he
    have := fml_incidence hok e he
    rw [hfml] at this; exact this
  have hlenT : (targetGraph cyc f).length = pt.M + (if cyc then K else 0) := by
    rw [targetGraph, List.length_append, hinc_len]
    cases cyc <;> simp [variableCycle_length, K]
  refine ⟨⟨pt, K, estar, fun v => if a v then 1 else 0, tsel, et⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · exact hok
    · intro j hj
      simp only [pt, canonTables] at hj
      simp only [pt, canon_kk f j hj]
      exact h3 f[j] (List.getElem_mem hj)
    · intro j hj
      simp only [pt, canonTables] at hj
      obtain ⟨hts, hev⟩ := htsel j hj
      obtain ⟨_, hV, hS⟩ := canon_occ_lit f j (tsel j) hj hts
      refine ⟨by simp only [pt]; rw [canon_kk f j hj]; exact hts, ?_⟩
      simp only [pt]
      rw [hV, hS]
      simp only [evalLiteral] at hev
      cases hpos : f[j][tsel j].positive <;> simp [hpos] at hev ⊢ <;> simp [hev]
    · intro e he
      have hsum : e < (f.map List.length).sum := he
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3'⟩ := locate_spec _ e hsum
      have hj : (locate (f.map List.length) e).1 < f.length := by simpa using h1
      have ht : (locate (f.map List.length) e).2 < f[(locate (f.map List.length) e).1].length := by
        rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj] at h2
        simpa using h2
      obtain ⟨hV, _, _, _⟩ := canon_VS_of_locate f e _ _ rfl hj ht
      simp only [pt]; rw [hV]
      exact hKlt _ (List.getElem_mem hj) _ (List.getElem_mem ht)
    · intro hM
      rcases hKmax with h0 | ⟨cl, hcl, l, hl, _⟩
      · exact h0
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hcl
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hl
        have := (canon_occ_lit f j t hj ht).1
        simp only [pt] at hM; omega
    · exact hestar.1
    · simp only; rw [hn2, hlenT]
    · intro e he
      dsimp only at he ⊢
      have hti := hinc e he
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := halfEdgeEnd_of_getElem? _ e _ _ hti
      rw [targetGraph] at hends
      have he0 : 2 * e < 2 * et.n2 := by rw [hn2, hlenT]; omega
      have he1 : 2 * e + 1 < 2 * et.n2 := by rw [hn2, hlenT]; omega
      obtain ⟨v0, hv0, hE0⟩ := hends (2 * e) he0
      obtain ⟨v1, hv1, hE1⟩ := hends (2 * e + 1) he1
      rw [halfEdgeEnd_append_left _ _ _ (by rw [hinc_len]; omega), h0] at hv0
      rw [halfEdgeEnd_append_left _ _ _ (by rw [hinc_len]; omega), h1] at hv1
      rw [← Option.some.inj hv0] at hE0
      rw [← Option.some.inj hv1] at hE1
      exact ⟨hE0, hE1⟩
    · intro hcyc i hi
      subst hcyc
      dsimp only at hi ⊢
      have hcy := variableCycle_getElem? f i hi
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := halfEdgeEnd_of_getElem? _ i _ _ hcy
      rw [targetGraph] at hends
      simp only [ite_true] at hends hlenT
      have he0 : 2 * (pt.M + i) < 2 * et.n2 := by rw [hn2, hlenT]; omega
      have he1 : 2 * (pt.M + i) + 1 < 2 * et.n2 := by rw [hn2, hlenT]; omega
      obtain ⟨v0, hv0, hE0⟩ := hends _ he0
      obtain ⟨v1, hv1, hE1⟩ := hends _ he1
      rw [halfEdgeEnd_append_right _ _ _ (by rw [hinc_len]; omega), hinc_len,
        show 2 * (pt.M + i) - 2 * pt.M = 2 * i by omega, h0] at hv0
      rw [halfEdgeEnd_append_right _ _ _ (by rw [hinc_len]; omega), hinc_len,
        show 2 * (pt.M + i) + 1 - 2 * pt.M = 2 * i + 1 by omega, h1] at hv1
      rw [← Option.some.inj hv0] at hE0
      rw [← Option.some.inj hv1] at hE1
      refine ⟨hE0, ?_⟩
      rw [hE1]
      by_cases hlast : i + 1 = variableCount f
      · simp [hlast, encodeEnd, K]
      · simp [hlast, encodeEnd, K]
    · exact hemb
  · 
    intro τ hτ i hi
    simp only [numTables] at hτ
    simp only [tableSize] at hi
    simp only [fieldWidth]
    have hm := hok.m_le
    have hM := hok.M_le
    have hKL : K ≤ (encode f).length := by
      rcases hKmax with h0 | ⟨cl, hcl, l, hl, hlK⟩
      · simp only [K]; omega
      · have := var_lt_length f cl hcl l hl; simp only [K]; omega
    have hn2L : et.n2 ≤ 2 * (encode f).length := by
      rw [hn2, targetGraph, List.length_append, incidenceGraph_length]
      have hM' : (f.map List.length).sum ≤ (encode f).length := hM
      cases cyc <;> simp [variableCycle_length] <;> simp only [K] at hKL <;> omega
    have hτ' : τ = 0 ∨ τ = 1 ∨ τ = 2 ∨ τ = 3 ∨ τ = 4 ∨ τ = 5 ∨ τ = 6 ∨ τ = 7 ∨ τ = 8 ∨
        τ = 9 ∨ τ = 10 ∨ τ = 11 ∨ τ = 12 ∨ τ = 13 ∨ τ = 14 ∨ τ = 15 ∨ τ = 16 ∨ τ = 17 ∨
        τ = 18 ∨ τ = 19 ∨ τ = 20 ∨ τ = 21 := by omega
    have hest' := hestar.2
    rcases hτ' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl |
      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · simp only [VCert.tab]
      dsimp only [pt, K, estar]
      repeat' split
      all_goals omega
    · show (canonTables f).kk i < _; have := canon_kk_le f i; omega
    · show (canonTables f).O i < _; have := canon_O_le f i; omega
    · show (canonTables f).P i < _; have := canon_P_le f i; omega
    · show tsel i < _
      by_cases hif : i < f.length
      · obtain ⟨ht, _⟩ := htsel i hif
        have := h3 f[i] (List.getElem_mem hif)
        omega
      · simp only [tsel, hif, dite_false]; omega
    · show (locate (f.map List.length) i).1 < _
      have := locate_fst_le (f.map List.length) i
      simp only [canonTables] at hm
      simp only [List.length_map] at this; omega
    · show (locate (f.map List.length) i).2 < _
      have := locate_snd_le (f.map List.length) i; omega
    · show (canonTables f).V i < _; have := canon_V_le f i; omega
    · show (canonTables f).S i < _; simp only [canonTables]; split <;> omega
    · show (canonTables f).Q i < _; have := canon_Q_le f i; omega
    · show (if a i then 1 else 0) < _; split <;> omega
    · show et.EN i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · obtain ⟨v, hv, hE⟩ := hends i hd
        rw [hE]
        have := targetGraph_end_bound hv
        omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).1]; omega
    · show et.N i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).1; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.1]; omega
    · show et.F i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).2.1; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.2.1]; omega
    · show et.R i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).2.2.1; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.2.2.1]; omega
    · show et.FL i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).2.2.2.1; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.2.2.2.1]; omega
    · show et.CL i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).2.2.2.2.1; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.2.2.2.2.1]; omega
    · show et.D i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).2.2.2.2.2.1; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.2.2.2.2.2.1]; omega
    · show et.SU i < _
      by_cases hd : i < 2 * et.n2
      · have := (hbnd i hd).2.2.2.2.2.2; omega
      · rw [(hzero i (by omega)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2]; omega
    · show et.cR i < _; have := (hcnt i).1; omega
    · show et.cF i < _; have := (hcnt i).2.1; omega
    · show et.cC i < _; have := (hcnt i).2.2; omega

name: Complexity.Planar.idxOf_getElem
statement: theorem idxOf_getElem (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) : l.idxOf l[p] = p
proof:
:=
  hl.idxOf_getElem p hp

name: Complexity.Planar.getD_eq
statement: theorem getD_eq (p : Nat) (hp : p < l.length) : l.getD p 0 = l[p]
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hp]

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_getElem
statement:
theorem rnext_getElem (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) :
    rnext l l[p] = l[(p + 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rnext
  rw [idxOf_getElem hl hp, getD_eq _ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))]

name: Complexity.Planar.rprev_getElem
statement:
theorem rprev_getElem (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) :
    rprev l l[p] = l[(p + l.length - 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rprev
  rw [idxOf_getElem hl hp, getD_eq _ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))]

name: Complexity.Planar.mem_getElem
statement: theorem mem_getElem {d : Nat} (hd : d ∈ l) : ∃ p, ∃ hp : p < l.length, l[p] = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hd
  exact ⟨p, hp, he⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_mem
statement: theorem rnext_mem {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rnext l d ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_getElem hd
  rw [rnext_getElem hl hp]
  exact List.getElem_mem _

name: Complexity.Planar.rprev_mem
statement: theorem rprev_mem {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rprev l d ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_getElem hd
  rw [rprev_getElem hl hp]
  exact List.getElem_mem _

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_rprev
statement: theorem rnext_rprev {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rnext l (rprev l d) = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_getElem hd
  rw [rprev_getElem hl hp, rnext_getElem hl (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))]
  congr 1
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p with h0 | h0
  · subst h0
    rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show l.length - 1 < l.length by omega),
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ l.length by omega), Nat.mod_self]
  · rw [show p + l.length - 1 = (p - 1) + l.length by omega, Nat.add_mod_right,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show p - 1 < l.length by omega), Nat.sub_add_cancel h0,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp]

name: Complexity.Planar.rprev_rnext
statement: theorem rprev_rnext {d : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) : rprev l (rnext l d) = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_getElem hd
  rw [rnext_getElem hl hp, rprev_getElem hl (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))]
  congr 1
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (p + 1) l.length with h1 | h1
  · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h1, show p + 1 + l.length - 1 = p + l.length by omega,
      Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp]
  · have : p + 1 = l.length := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.mod_self, Nat.zero_add,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show l.length - 1 < l.length by omega)]
    omega

name: Complexity.Planar.iterate_rnext
statement:
theorem iterate_rnext (hl : l.Nodup) {p : Nat} (hp : p < l.length) (k : Nat) :
    iterate (rnext l) k l[p] = l[(p + k) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing p with
  | zero => simp [iterate, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [iterate]
    rw [rnext_getElem hl hp, ih (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))]
    congr 1
    rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← Nat.add_mod, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1 k]

name: Complexity.Planar.rnext_reach
statement:
theorem rnext_reach {d d' : Nat} (hl : l.Nodup) (hd : d ∈ l) (hd' : d' ∈ l) :
    ∃ k, iterate (rnext l) k d = d'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_getElem hd
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := mem_getElem hd'
  refine ⟨q + l.length - p, ?_⟩
  rw [iterate_rnext hl hp]
  congr 1
  rw [show p + (q + l.length - p) = q + l.length by omega, Nat.add_mod_right,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hq]

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.vA_eq
statement: theorem vA_eq (n : Nat) : vA P n = (n + 1) * vB P n
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.vB_eq
statement: theorem vB_eq (n : Nat) : vB P n = 5 * vM P n * vR P n + 1
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.vR_eq
statement: theorem vR_eq (n : Nat) : vR P n = 2 * vW P n
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.vW_pos
statement: theorem vW_pos (n : Nat) : 1 ≤ vW P n
proof:
:= by
  show 1 ≤ (Wx P).eval (fun _ => n)
  simp only [Wx, NumExpr.eval]
  omega

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.at1_eval
statement:
theorem at1_eval (e : NumExpr 1) (m n L : Nat) :
    (at1 e).eval (extend m (extend n (fun _ => L))) = e.eval (fun _ => n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [at1]

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.lenE_eval
statement:
theorem lenE_eval (m n L : Nat) :
    (lenE P).eval (extend m (extend n (fun _ => L))) = 2 * vA P n + 1 + 5 * (m * vR P n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lenE, NumExpr.eval, at1_eval, extend_zero]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.unique_dims
statement:
theorem unique_dims {n M n' m' : Nat} (hM : M ≤ vM P n) (hm' : m' ≤ vM P n')
    (h : 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') = 2 * vA P n + 1 + 5 * (M * vR P n)) :
    n' = n ∧ m' = M
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x m, m ≤ vM P x → 5 * (m * vR P x) + 1 ≤ vB P x := by
    intro x m hm
    rw [vB_eq]
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (vR P x) hm
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
    omega
  have k1 := key n M hM
  have k2 := key n' m' hm'
  have eA : ∀ x, vA P x = x * vB P x + vB P x := by
    intro x; rw [vA_eq, Nat.succ_mul]
  rw [eA, eA] at h
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy n' n with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    have hb : vB P n' ≤ vB P n := mono_Bx P n' n (by omega)
    have p1 : n' * vB P n' ≤ n' * vB P n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb
    have p2 : (n' + 1) * vB P n ≤ n * vB P n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hlt
    rw [Nat.succ_mul] at p2
    omega
  · subst heq
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    have hR : 0 < vR P n' := by rw [vR_eq]; have := vW_pos P n'; omega
    have : m' * vR P n' = M * vR P n' := by omega
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hR this
  · exfalso
    have hb : vB P n ≤ vB P n' := mono_Bx P n n' (by omega)
    have p1 : n * vB P n ≤ n * vB P n' := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb
    have p2 : (n + 1) * vB P n' ≤ n' * vB P n' := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hgt
    rw [Nat.succ_mul] at p2
    omega

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.flatMap_single
statement:
theorem flatMap_single {α : Type} {N i0 : Nat} (hi0 : i0 < N) (F : Nat → List α)
    (h : ∀ i, i < N → i ≠ i0 → F i = []) : (List.range N).reverse.flatMap F = F i0
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => omega
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [range_reverse_succ_flatMap]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i0 N with hlt | hge
    · rw [h N (by omega) (by omega), ih hlt (fun i hi hne => h i (by omega) hne), List.nil_append]
    · have : i0 = N := by omega
      subst this
      have : (List.range i0).reverse.flatMap F = [] := by
        rw [List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff]
        intro i hi
        simp only [List.mem_reverse, List.mem_range] at hi
        exact h i (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [this, List.append_nil]

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.stage2_emit
statement:
theorem stage2_emit (G : ClauseProgram 3) (w : Word) {n M : Nat} (hM : M ≤ vM P n)
    (hw : w.length = 2 * vA P n + 1 + 5 * (M * vR P n)) :
    (stage2 P G).emit w (fun _ => w.length) =
      G.emit w (extend M (extend n (fun _ => w.length)))
proof:
:= by
  have hB : 1 ≤ vB P n := by rw [vB_eq]; omega
  have hnA : n < vA P n := by
    rw [vA_eq, Nat.succ_mul]
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n hB
    omega
  have hR : 1 ≤ vR P n := by rw [vR_eq]; have := vW_pos P n; omega
  have hMR : M ≤ M * vR P n := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M hR; omega
  have body : ∀ n' m', (ClauseProgram.ifLe (lenE P) (.var 2)
      (.ifLe (.var 2) (lenE P) (.ifLe (.var 0) (at1 (Mx P)) G .skip) .skip) .skip).emit w
        (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) =
      if 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') = w.length ∧ m' ≤ vM P n' then
        G.emit w (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) else [] := by
    intro n' m'
    have e0 : (NumExpr.var 0 : NumExpr 3).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) = m' :=
      rfl
    have e2 : (NumExpr.var 2 : NumExpr 3).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) =
        w.length := rfl
    have eM : (at1 (Mx P)).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) = vM P n' :=
      at1_eval _ _ _ _
    show (if (lenE P).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) ≤
        (NumExpr.var 2 : NumExpr 3).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) then
        (if (NumExpr.var 2 : NumExpr 3).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) ≤
          (lenE P).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) then
          (if (NumExpr.var 0 : NumExpr 3).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) ≤
            (at1 (Mx P)).eval (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) then
            G.emit w (extend m' (extend n' (fun _ => w.length))) else []) else []) else []) = _
    rw [lenE_eval, e0, e2, eM]
    by_cases hc : 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') = w.length ∧ m' ≤ vM P n'
    · rw [ite_eq_left hc]
      have c1 : 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') ≤ w.length := by omega
      have c2 : w.length ≤ 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') := by omega
      simp only [c1, c2, hc.2, ↓reduceIte]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hc]
      by_cases c1 : 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') ≤ w.length <;>
        by_cases c2 : w.length ≤ 2 * vA P n' + 1 + 5 * (m' * vR P n') <;>
        by_cases c3 : m' ≤ vM P n' <;>
        simp only [c1, c2, c3, ↓reduceIte] <;>
        exact absurd ⟨by omega, c3⟩ hc
  unfold stage2
  simp only [ClauseProgram.emit_forDown]
  have e0 : (NumExpr.var 0 : NumExpr 1).eval (fun _ => w.length) = w.length := rfl
  have e1 : ∀ n', (NumExpr.var 1 : NumExpr 2).eval (extend n' (fun _ => w.length)) =
      w.length := fun _ => rfl
  rw [e0]
  simp only [e1, body]
  rw [flatMap_single (i0 := n) (by omega)]
  · rw [flatMap_single (i0 := M) (by omega)]
    · rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hw.symm, hM⟩]
    · intro m' _ hne
      rw [ite_eq_right]
      intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact hne (unique_dims P hM h2 (h1.trans hw)).2
  · intro n' _ hne
    rw [List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff]
    intro m' _
    rw [ite_eq_right]
    intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact hne (unique_dims P hM h2 (h1.trans hw)).1

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.sat_iff_bits
statement:
theorem sat_iff_bits (φ : CNF) (W : Nat) (hW : ∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c, l.var < W)
    (bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool)
    (hb : ∀ j (hj : j < φ.length), ∀ v, v < W → bits j v = (bitB φ[j] v 1, bitB φ[j] v 0)) :
    (∃ a : Assignment, ∀ j, j < φ.length → ∃ v, v < W ∧
      litSat (bits j v).1 (bits j v).2 (a v) = true) ↔ Satisfiable φ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    unfold evalCNF
    rw [List.all_eq_true]
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hc
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hs⟩ := ha j hj
    rw [hb j hj v hv] at hs
    unfold evalClause
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    unfold litSat bitB at hs
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hs
    rcases hs with ⟨⟨l, hl, hlv, hlp⟩, hav⟩ | ⟨⟨l, hl, hlv, hlp⟩, hav⟩
    · refine ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
      unfold evalLiteral
      simp only [show (1 == 1) = true from rfl] at hlp
      rw [show l.positive = true by simpa using hlp, hlv]
      exact hav
    · refine ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
      unfold evalLiteral
      have : l.positive = false := by simpa using hlp
      rw [this, hlv]
      simpa using hav
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    unfold evalCNF at ha
    rw [List.all_eq_true] at ha
    have hc := ha φ[j] (List.getElem_mem hj)
    unfold evalClause at hc
    rw [List.any_eq_true] at hc
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hev⟩ := hc
    refine ⟨l.var, hW _ (List.getElem_mem hj) l hl, ?_⟩
    rw [hb j hj l.var (hW _ (List.getElem_mem hj) l hl)]
    unfold litSat bitB
    unfold evalLiteral at hev
    cases hp : l.positive
    · rw [hp] at hev
      have hneg : (φ[j].any fun l' => l'.var == l.var && l'.positive == ((0 : Nat) == 1)) = true :=
        List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨l, hl, by simp [hp]⟩
      rw [hneg]
      simp at hev
      simp [hev]
    · rw [hp] at hev
      have hpos : (φ[j].any fun l' => l'.var == l.var && l'.positive == ((1 : Nat) == 1)) = true :=
        List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨l, hl, by simp [hp]⟩
      rw [hpos]
      simp at hev
      simp [hev]

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.word1_eq
statement:
theorem word1_eq : word1 P x = encode (List.replicate (vA P x.length) [] ++
    ((P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).flatMap (rowBits (vW P x.length))).map unitOf)
proof:
:= by
  unfold word1
  rw [stage1_emit]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.word1_length
statement:
theorem word1_length : (word1 P x).length =
    2 * vA P x.length + 1 + 5 * ((P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length * vR P x.length)
proof:
:= by
  rw [word1_eq, table_length]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.bits_word1
statement:
theorem bits_word1 : ∀ j (hj : j < (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length), ∀ v, v < vW P x.length →
    bitsW (word1 P x) (vA P x.length) (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length (vR P x.length)
      (vW P x.length) j v =
      (bitB (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length))[j] v 1, bitB (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length))[j] v 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj v hv
  unfold bitsW
  rw [vR_eq, word1_eq, table_bit _ _ _ hj hv (by omega), table_bit _ _ _ hj hv (by omega)]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.gridOut_eq
statement:
theorem gridOut_eq : gridOut P x = gridCNF (vW P x.length) (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length
    (bitsW (word1 P x) (vA P x.length) (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length (vR P x.length)
      (vW P x.length))
proof:
:= by
  unfold gridOut
  rw [stage2_emit P _ _ (emit_length_le P x) (word1_length P x), cycG, gridProg_emit]
  simp only [at1_eval]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.plainOut_eq
statement:
theorem plainOut_eq : plainOut P x = plainCNF (vW P x.length) (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length
    (bitsW (word1 P x) (vA P x.length) (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)).length (vR P x.length)
      (vW P x.length))
proof:
:= by
  unfold plainOut
  rw [stage2_emit P _ _ (emit_length_le P x) (word1_length P x), plainG, plainProg_emit]
  simp only [at1_eval]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.gridOut_sat
statement: theorem gridOut_sat : Satisfiable (gridOut P x) ↔ Satisfiable (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridOut_eq, grid_satisfiable_iff]
  exact sat_iff_bits _ _ (emit_var_lt P x) _ (bits_word1 P x)

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.plainOut_sat
statement: theorem plainOut_sat : Satisfiable (plainOut P x) ↔ Satisfiable (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length))
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainOut_eq, plain_satisfiable_iff, grid_satisfiable_iff]
  exact sat_iff_bits _ _ (emit_var_lt P x) _ (bits_word1 P x)

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.gridOut_planar
statement: theorem gridOut_planar : IsCyclePlanarThreeCNF (gridOut P x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridOut_eq]; exact grid_isCyclePlanar _ _ _

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.plainOut_planar
statement: theorem plainOut_planar : IsPlanarThreeCNF (plainOut P x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainOut_eq]; exact plain_isPlanar _ _ _

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.cyclePlanar_encode_iff
statement:
theorem cyclePlanar_encode_iff (f : CNF) :
    CyclePlanarThreeSAT (encode f) ↔ IsCyclePlanarThreeCNF f ∧ Satisfiable f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, hc, hs⟩
    rw [encode_injective g f hg] at hc hs
    exact ⟨hc, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, hs⟩
    exact ⟨f, rfl, hc, hs⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.planar_encode_iff
statement:
theorem planar_encode_iff (f : CNF) :
    PlanarThreeSAT (encode f) ↔ IsPlanarThreeCNF f ∧ Satisfiable f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, hc, hs⟩
    rw [encode_injective g f hg] at hc hs
    exact ⟨hc, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, hs⟩
    exact ⟨f, rfl, hc, hs⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.polyTime_two_stages
statement:
theorem polyTime_two_stages (P G : ClauseProgram 1) :
    PolyTime (fun x => encode (G.emit (encode (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)))
      (fun _ => (encode (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length))).length)))
proof:
:=
  polyTime_comp (f := fun x => encode (P.emit x (fun _ => x.length)))
    (g := fun w => encode (G.emit w (fun _ => w.length)))
    (polyTime_emitter G) (polyTime_emitter P)

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.cyclePlanarThreeSAT_npHard
statement: theorem cyclePlanarThreeSAT_npHard : NPHard CyclePlanarThreeSAT
proof:
:= by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := CookLevinEmitter.inNP_emitter hL
  refine ⟨fun x => encode (gridOut P x), polyTime_two_stages (stage1 P) (stage2 P (cycG P)), ?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [hP x, SAT_encode_iff, cyclePlanar_encode_iff, gridOut_sat]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨gridOut_planar P x, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Emit.planarThreeSAT_npHard
statement: theorem planarThreeSAT_npHard : NPHard PlanarThreeSAT
proof:
:= by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := CookLevinEmitter.inNP_emitter hL
  refine ⟨fun x => encode (plainOut P x), polyTime_two_stages (stage1 P) (stage2 P (plainG P)), ?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [hP x, SAT_encode_iff, planar_encode_iff, plainOut_sat]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨plainOut_planar P x, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.evalClause_inst
statement:
theorem evalClause_inst (g : Assignment) (o : Nat) (odd : Bool) (t : TCl) :
    evalClause g (inst o odd t) = evalT (fun p => g (o + p)) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalClause inst evalT
  split <;> simp [List.any_map, Function.comp_def, evalLiteral]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.cell_complete
statement:
theorem cell_complete : ∀ bp bn cin x : Bool, ∀ t ∈ cellT bp bn,
    evalT (fun p => (cellVals cin x (cin || litSat bp bn x)).getD p false) t = true
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.cross_sound
statement:
theorem cross_sound : ∀ b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 : Bool, ∀ b0 : Bool,
    (∀ t ∈ crossT, evalT (fun p => [b0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7, b8, b9].getD p false) t = true) →
      b8 = b1 ∧ b9 = b2
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.or_sound
statement:
theorem or_sound : ∀ bp bn b0 b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 : Bool,
    (∀ t ∈ orT bp bn,
      evalT (fun p => [b0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7, b1, b2].getD p false) t = true) →
      b0 = false → b2 = true → litSat bp bn b1 = true
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.any_congr_mem
statement:
theorem any_congr_mem {α : Type} {l : List α} {f g : α → Bool} (h : ∀ x ∈ l, f x = g x) :
    l.any f = l.any g
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a List.mem_cons_self,
      ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.getD_ten
statement:
theorem getD_ten (L : Nat → Bool) {q : Nat} (hq : q < 10) :
    L q = [L 0, L 1, L 2, L 3, L 4, L 5, L 6, L 7, L 8, L 9].getD q false
proof:
:= by
  match q, hq with
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | 1, _ => rfl
  | 2, _ => rfl
  | 3, _ => rfl
  | 4, _ => rfl
  | 5, _ => rfl
  | 6, _ => rfl
  | 7, _ => rfl
  | 8, _ => rfl
  | 9, _ => rfl
  | q + 10, h => exact absurd h (by omega)

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.evalT_congr
statement:
theorem evalT_congr {L L' : Nat → Bool} {t : TCl} (ht : ∀ p ∈ tpos t, p < 10)
    (h : ∀ p, p < 10 → L p = L' p) : evalT L t = evalT L' t
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalT
  apply any_congr_mem
  intro x hx
  have : x.1 < 10 := ht _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  rw [h _ this]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.pos_lt_ten
statement: theorem pos_lt_ten {bp bn : Bool} {t : TCl} (ht : t ∈ cellT bp bn) : ∀ p ∈ tpos t, p < 10
proof:
:=
  (cellT_shape bp bn t ht).2.2.2.1

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.cell_sound
statement:
theorem cell_sound {bp bn : Bool} (L : Nat → Bool) (h : ∀ t ∈ cellT bp bn, evalT L t = true) :
    L 8 = L 1 ∧ L 9 = L 2 ∧ (L 0 = false → L 2 = true → litSat bp bn (L 1) = true)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ t ∈ crossT,
      evalT (fun p => [L 0, L 1, L 2, L 3, L 4, L 5, L 6, L 7, L 8, L 9].getD p false) t = true := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' : t ∈ cellT bp bn := List.mem_append_right _ ht
    rw [← h t ht']
    exact evalT_congr (pos_lt_ten ht') (fun p hp => (getD_ten L hp).symm)
  obtain ⟨h81, h92⟩ := cross_sound (L 1) (L 2) (L 3) (L 4) (L 5) (L 6) (L 7) (L 8) (L 9) (L 0) hc
  refine ⟨h81, h92, ?_⟩
  apply or_sound bp bn (L 0) (L 1) (L 2) (L 3) (L 4) (L 5) (L 6) (L 7)
  intro t ht
  have ht' : t ∈ cellT bp bn := List.mem_append_left _ ht
  have := h t ht'
  rw [evalT_congr (pos_lt_ten ht') (fun p hp => getD_ten L hp), h81, h92] at this
  exact this

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.par_even
statement: theorem par_even (k : Nat) : par (2 * k) = false
proof:
:= by
  unfold par; rw [show 2 * k % 2 = 0 by omega]; rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.par_odd
statement: theorem par_odd (k : Nat) : par (2 * k + 1) = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold par; rw [show (2 * k + 1) % 2 = 1 by omega]; rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.column_mem
statement:
theorem column_mem {W m j : Nat} {bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool} (hj : j < m) {c : Clause}
    (hc : c ∈ column W j (par j) bits) : c ∈ gridCNF W m bits
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridCNF_eq]
  simp only [List.mem_append]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ : ∃ k, j = 2 * k ∨ j = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨j / 2, by omega⟩
  · rw [par_even] at hc
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (mem_colsE.mpr ⟨k, by omega, hc⟩)))
  · rw [par_odd] at hc
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (mem_colsO.mpr ⟨k, by omega, hc⟩)))

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.rbEven_mem
statement:
theorem rbEven_mem {W m k v : Nat} {bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool} (hk : 2 * k + 2 ≤ m)
    (hv : v < W) {c : Clause} (hc : c ∈ rbEven W (2 * k) v) : c ∈ gridCNF W m bits
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridCNF_eq]
  simp only [List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr (mem_rbsE.mpr ⟨k, hk, v, hv, hc⟩))

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.rbOdd_mem
statement:
theorem rbOdd_mem {W m k v : Nat} {bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool} (hk : 2 * k + 3 ≤ m)
    (hv : v < W) {c : Clause} (hc : c ∈ rbOdd W (2 * k + 1) v) : c ∈ gridCNF W m bits
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridCNF_eq]
  simp only [List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr (mem_rbsO.mpr ⟨k, hk, v, hv, hc⟩)

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.cell_mem
statement:
theorem cell_mem {W j idx : Nat} {odd : Bool} {bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool} (hidx : idx < W)
    {t : TCl} (ht : t ∈ cellT (bits j (row W odd idx)).1 (bits j (row W odd idx)).2) :
    inst (cellOff W j idx) odd t ∈ column W j odd bits
proof:
:= by
  unfold column
  simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_reverse, List.mem_range]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨idx, hidx, by unfold cellCNF; exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩)

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.start_mem
statement:
theorem start_mem {W j : Nat} {odd : Bool} {bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool} {c : Clause}
    (hc : c ∈ startG W j) : c ∈ column W j odd bits
proof:
:= by
  unfold column
  exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ hc)

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.end_mem
statement:
theorem end_mem {W j : Nat} {odd : Bool} {bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool} {c : Clause}
    (hc : c ∈ endG W j) : c ∈ column W j odd bits
proof:
:= by
  unfold column
  exact List.mem_append_right _ hc

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.row_true
statement: theorem row_true {W idx : Nat} : row W true idx = W - 1 - idx
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.row_false
statement: theorem row_false {W idx : Nat} : row W false idx = idx
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.row_lt
statement: theorem row_lt {W : Nat} (odd : Bool) {idx : Nat} (h : idx < W) : row W odd idx < W
proof:
:= by
  unfold row; split <;> omega

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.row_row
statement: theorem row_row {W : Nat} (odd : Bool) {idx : Nat} (h : idx < W) : row W odd (row W odd idx) = idx
proof:
:= by
  unfold row; split <;> omega

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.two_equal
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evalClause, evalLiteral, List.any_cons, List.any_nil, Bool.or_false] at h1 h2
  cases hx : g x <;> cases hy : g y <;> simp_all

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.two_equal'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evalClause, evalLiteral, List.any_cons, List.any_nil, Bool.or_false] at h1 h2
  cases hx : g x <;> cases hy : g y <;> simp_all

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.switch_exists
statement:
theorem switch_exists (f : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ W, f 0 = false → f W = true → ∃ i, i < W ∧ f i = false ∧ f (i + 1) = true
  | 0, h0, hW => by rw [h0] at hW; cases hW
  | W + 1, h0, hW => by
    cases h : f W
    · exact ⟨W, by omega, h, hW⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= switch_exists f W h0 h
      exact ⟨i, by omega, h1, h2⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.cell_local
statement:
theorem cell_local {j idx : Nat} (hj : j < m) (hidx : idx < W) :
    ∀ t ∈ cellT (bits j (row W (par j) idx)).1 (bits j (row W (par j) idx)).2,
      evalT (fun p => g (cellOff W j idx + p)) t = true
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [← evalClause_inst]
  exact hg _ (column_mem hj (cell_mem hidx ht))

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.copy_eq
statement:
theorem copy_eq {j idx : Nat} (hj : j < m) (hidx : idx < W) :
    g (cellOff W j idx + 8) = g (cellOff W j idx + 1)
proof:
:=
  (cell_sound _ (cell_local hg hj hidx)).1

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.copies
statement:
theorem copies {j : Nat} (hj : j < m) :
    ∀ idx, idx < W → g (cellOff W j idx + 1) = g (cellOff W 0 (row W (par j) idx) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => intro idx _; rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    intro idx hidx
    obtain ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ : ∃ k, j = 2 * k ∨ j = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨j / 2, by omega⟩
    · 
      have hv : W - 1 - idx < W := by omega
      have m1 := rbEven_mem (bits := bits) (show 2 * k + 2 ≤ m by omega) hv
        (c := [⟨cellOff W (2 * k) (W - 1 - idx) + 8, false⟩,
          ⟨cellOff W (2 * k + 1) (W - 1 - (W - 1 - idx)) + 1, true⟩]) (by simp [rbEven])
      have m2 := rbEven_mem (bits := bits) (show 2 * k + 2 ≤ m by omega) hv
        (c := [⟨cellOff W (2 * k) (W - 1 - idx) + 8, true⟩,
          ⟨cellOff W (2 * k + 1) (W - 1 - (W - 1 - idx)) + 1, false⟩]) (by simp [rbEven])
      have h := two_equal (hg _ m1) (hg _ m2)
      rw [show W - 1 - (W - 1 - idx) = idx by omega] at h
      rw [h, copy_eq hg (by omega) hv, ih (by omega) _ hv, par_even, par_odd, row_true, row_false]
    · 
      have hv : W - 1 - idx < W := by omega
      have m1 := rbOdd_mem (bits := bits) (show 2 * k + 3 ≤ m by omega) hidx
        (c := [⟨cellOff W (2 * k + 1 + 1) idx + 1, true⟩,
          ⟨cellOff W (2 * k + 1) (W - 1 - idx) + 8, false⟩]) (by simp [rbOdd])
      have m2 := rbOdd_mem (bits := bits) (show 2 * k + 3 ≤ m by omega) hidx
        (c := [⟨cellOff W (2 * k + 1 + 1) idx + 1, false⟩,
          ⟨cellOff W (2 * k + 1) (W - 1 - idx) + 8, true⟩]) (by simp [rbOdd])
      have h := two_equal' (hg _ m1) (hg _ m2)
      rw [h, copy_eq hg (by omega) hv, ih (by omega) _ hv, par_odd,
        show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by omega, par_even, row_true, row_false,
        show W - 1 - (W - 1 - idx) = idx by omega]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.start_false
statement: theorem start_false {j : Nat} (hj : j < m) : g (cellOff W j 0) = false
proof:
:= by
  have m1 := column_mem (W := W) (bits := bits) hj (start_mem (odd := par j) (bits := bits)
    (c := [⟨colBase W j, true⟩, ⟨colBase W j + 1, false⟩]) (by simp [startG]))
  have m2 := column_mem (W := W) (bits := bits) hj (start_mem (odd := par j) (bits := bits)
    (c := [⟨colBase W j + 1, false⟩, ⟨colBase W j, false⟩]) (by simp [startG]))
  have h1 := hg _ m1
  have h2 := hg _ m2
  simp only [evalClause, evalLiteral, List.any_cons, List.any_nil, Bool.or_false] at h1 h2
  have : cellOff W j 0 = colBase W j + 1 := by unfold cellOff; omega
  rw [this]
  cases hx : g (colBase W j) <;> cases hy : g (colBase W j + 1) <;> simp_all

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.end_true
statement: theorem end_true {j : Nat} (hj : j < m) : g (cellOff W j W) = true
proof:
:= by
  have m1 := column_mem (W := W) (bits := bits) hj (end_mem (odd := par j) (bits := bits)
    (c := [⟨cellOff W j W, true⟩, ⟨cellOff W j W + 1, true⟩]) (by simp [endG]))
  have m2 := column_mem (W := W) (bits := bits) hj (end_mem (odd := par j) (bits := bits)
    (c := [⟨cellOff W j W + 1, false⟩, ⟨cellOff W j W, true⟩]) (by simp [endG]))
  have h1 := hg _ m1
  have h2 := hg _ m2
  simp only [evalClause, evalLiteral, List.any_cons, List.any_nil, Bool.or_false] at h1 h2
  cases hx : g (cellOff W j W) <;> cases hy : g (cellOff W j W + 1) <;> simp_all

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.grid_sound
statement:
theorem grid_sound {j : Nat} (hj : j < m) :
    ∃ v, v < W ∧ litSat (bits j v).1 (bits j v).2 (g (cellOff W 0 v + 1)) = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨idx, hidx, h1, h2⟩ := switch_exists (fun i => g (cellOff W j i)) W
    (start_false hg hj) (end_true hg hj)
  have hs := cell_sound _ (cell_local hg hj hidx)
  have e9 : cellOff W j (idx + 1) = cellOff W j idx + 9 := by unfold cellOff; omega
  rw [e9] at h2
  have h3 : litSat (bits j (row W (par j) idx)).1 (bits j (row W (par j) idx)).2
      (g (cellOff W j idx + 1)) = true :=
    hs.2.2 (by simpa using h1) (by rw [← hs.2.1]; simpa using h2)
  refine ⟨row W (par j) idx, row_lt _ hidx, ?_⟩
  rw [← copies hg hj idx hidx]
  exact h3

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.decomp
statement:
theorem decomp {j r : Nat} (hr : r < 9 * W + 3) :
    (colBase W j + r) / (9 * W + 3) = j ∧ (colBase W j + r) % (9 * W + 3) = r
proof:
:= by
  unfold colBase colLen
  rw [Nat.mul_comm j, Nat.mul_add_div (by omega), Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr]
  exact ⟨by omega, rfl⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.chainV_succ
statement:
theorem chainV_succ (j idx : Nat) :
    chainV W bits a j (idx + 1) = (chainV W bits a j idx || cellSatB W bits a j idx)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chainV
  rw [List.range_succ, List.any_append]
  simp

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_chain
statement:
theorem gridAsg_chain {j idx : Nat} (h : idx ≤ W) :
    gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W j idx) = chainV W bits a j idx
proof:
:= by
  have hd := decomp W (j := j) (show 1 + 9 * idx < 9 * W + 3 by omega)
  have e : cellOff W j idx = colBase W j + (1 + 9 * idx) := by unfold cellOff; omega
  unfold gridAsg
  rw [e, hd.1, hd.2, ite_eq_right (by omega), show (1 + 9 * idx - 1) / 9 = idx by omega,
    show (1 + 9 * idx - 1) % 9 = 0 by omega]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_cell
statement:
theorem gridAsg_cell {j idx p : Nat} (h : idx < W) (hp : p < 9) :
    gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W j idx + p) =
      (cellVals (chainV W bits a j idx) (a (row W (par j) idx))
        (chainV W bits a j (idx + 1))).getD p false
proof:
:= by
  have hd := decomp W (j := j) (show 1 + 9 * idx + p < 9 * W + 3 by omega)
  have e : cellOff W j idx + p = colBase W j + (1 + 9 * idx + p) := by unfold cellOff; omega
  unfold gridAsg
  rw [e, hd.1, hd.2, ite_eq_right (by omega), show (1 + 9 * idx + p - 1) / 9 = idx by omega,
    show (1 + 9 * idx + p - 1) % 9 = p by omega]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_local
statement:
theorem gridAsg_local {j idx p : Nat} (h : idx < W) (hp : p < 10) :
    gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W j idx + p) =
      (cellVals (chainV W bits a j idx) (a (row W (par j) idx))
        (chainV W bits a j (idx + 1))).getD p false
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p 9 with hp9 | hp9
  · exact gridAsg_cell W bits a h hp9
  · have : p = 9 := by omega
    subst this
    rw [show cellOff W j idx + 9 = cellOff W j (idx + 1) by unfold cellOff; omega,
      gridAsg_chain W bits a (by omega)]
    rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_cellClause
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalClause_inst, evalT_congr (pos_lt_ten ht) (fun p hp => gridAsg_local W bits a h hp),
    chainV_succ]
  exact cell_complete _ _ _ _ t ht

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_column
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_column hc with hs | ⟨idx, hidx, t, ht, rfl⟩ | he
  · have h0 : gridAsg W bits a (colBase W j + 1) = false := by
      rw [show colBase W j + 1 = cellOff W j 0 by unfold cellOff; omega,
        gridAsg_chain W bits a (Nat.zero_le _)]
      rfl
    unfold startG at hs
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> simp [evalClause, evalLiteral, h0]
  · exact gridAsg_cellClause W bits a hidx ht
  · have h1 : gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W j W) = true := by
      rw [gridAsg_chain W bits a (Nat.le_refl _)]
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hs⟩ := hsat
      unfold chainV
      rw [List.any_eq_true]
      refine ⟨row W (par j) v, List.mem_range.mpr (row_lt _ hv), ?_⟩
      unfold cellSatB
      rw [row_row _ hv]
      exact hs
    unfold endG at he
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at he
    rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> simp [evalClause, evalLiteral, h1]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_rbEven
statement:
theorem gridAsg_rbEven {k v : Nat} (hv : v < W) {c : Clause} (hc : c ∈ rbEven W (2 * k) v) :
    evalClause (gridAsg W bits a) c = true
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W (2 * k) v + 8) = a v := by
    rw [gridAsg_cell W bits a hv (by omega), par_even, row_false]
    rfl
  have h2 : gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W (2 * k + 1) (W - 1 - v) + 1) = a v := by
    rw [gridAsg_cell W bits a (by omega) (by omega), par_odd, row_true,
      show W - 1 - (W - 1 - v) = v by omega]
    rfl
  unfold rbEven at hc
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hc
  rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;> simp [evalClause, evalLiteral, h1, h2]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.gridAsg_rbOdd
statement:
theorem gridAsg_rbOdd {k v : Nat} (hv : v < W) {c : Clause} (hc : c ∈ rbOdd W (2 * k + 1) v) :
    evalClause (gridAsg W bits a) c = true
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W (2 * k + 1 + 1) v + 1) = a v := by
    rw [gridAsg_cell W bits a hv (by omega), show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by omega,
      par_even, row_false]
    rfl
  have h2 : gridAsg W bits a (cellOff W (2 * k + 1) (W - 1 - v) + 8) = a v := by
    rw [gridAsg_cell W bits a (by omega) (by omega), par_odd, row_true,
      show W - 1 - (W - 1 - v) = v by omega]
    rfl
  unfold rbOdd at hc
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hc
  rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;> simp [evalClause, evalLiteral, h1, h2]

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.grid_complete
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalCNF
  rw [List.all_eq_true]
  intro c hc
  rw [gridCNF_eq] at hc
  simp only [List.mem_append] at hc
  rcases hc with ((hc | hc) | hc) | hc
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hc⟩ := mem_colsE.mp hc
    exact gridAsg_column W bits a (ha (2 * k) (by omega)) (by rw [par_even]; exact hc)
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hc⟩ := mem_colsO.mp hc
    exact gridAsg_column W bits a (ha (2 * k + 1) (by omega)) (by rw [par_odd]; exact hc)
  · obtain ⟨k, _, v, hv, hc⟩ := mem_rbsE.mp hc
    exact gridAsg_rbEven W bits a hv hc
  · obtain ⟨k, _, v, hv, hc⟩ := mem_rbsO.mp hc
    exact gridAsg_rbOdd W bits a hv hc

name: Complexity.Planar.Grid.grid_satisfiable_iff
statement:
theorem grid_satisfiable_iff (W m : Nat) (bits : Nat → Nat → Bool × Bool) :
    Satisfiable (gridCNF W m bits) ↔
      ∃ a : Assignment, ∀ j, j < m → ∃ v, v < W ∧ litSat (bits j v).1 (bits j v).2 (a v) = true
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    unfold evalCNF at hg
    rw [List.all_eq_true] at hg
    exact ⟨fun v => g (cellOff W 0 v + 1), fun j hj => grid_sound hg hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨gridAsg W bits a, grid_complete ha⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.leadOnes_le
statement: theorem leadOnes_le (u : List Bool) (o k : Nat) : leadOnes u o k ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing o with
  | zero => simp [leadOnes]
  | succ k ih => simp only [leadOnes]; split <;> have := ih (o + 1) <;> omega

name: Complexity.Planar.leadOnes_ones
statement:
theorem leadOnes_ones (u : List Bool) (o k : Nat) :
    ∀ i, i < leadOnes u o k → u[o + i]? = some true
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing o with
  | zero => simp [leadOnes]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hi
    simp only [leadOnes] at hi
    split at hi
    · next h =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simpa using h
      | succ i =>
        have := ih (o + 1) i (by omega)
        rwa [show o + 1 + i = o + (i + 1) by omega] at this
    · omega

name: Complexity.Planar.leadOnes_stop
statement:
theorem leadOnes_stop (u : List Bool) (o k : Nat) (h : leadOnes u o k < k) :
    NotOne u (o + leadOnes u o k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing o with
  | zero => simp [leadOnes] at h
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [leadOnes] at h ⊢
    split
    · next hb =>
      simp only [hb, ite_true] at h
      have := ih (o + 1) (by omega)
      rwa [show o + 1 + leadOnes u (o + 1) k = o + (leadOnes u (o + 1) k + 1) by omega] at this
    · next hb => simpa [NotOne] using hb

name: Complexity.Planar.leadOnes_eq
statement:
theorem leadOnes_eq (u : List Bool) (o k v : Nat) (hv : v ≤ k)
    (hones : ∀ i, i < v → u[o + i]? = some true) (hstop : v < k → NotOne u (o + v)) :
    leadOnes u o k = v
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing o v with
  | zero => simp [leadOnes]; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [leadOnes]
    cases v with
    | zero =>
      have := hstop (by omega)
      simp only [NotOne, Nat.add_zero] at this
      simp [this]
    | succ v =>
      have h0 := hones 0 (by omega)
      simp only [Nat.add_zero] at h0
      simp only [h0, ite_true]
      have := ih (o + 1) v (by omega)
        (fun i hi => by rw [show o + 1 + i = o + (i + 1) by omega]; exact hones (i + 1) (by omega))
        (fun hlt => by rw [show o + 1 + v = o + (v + 1) by omega]; exact hstop (by omega))
      omega

name: Complexity.Planar.tval_lt
statement:
theorem tval_lt {u : List Bool} {o B : Nat} (hwf : FieldWF u o B) (hB : 0 < B) :
    tval u o B < B
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (tval u o B) B with h | h
  · exact h
  · have heq : tval u o B = B := Nat.le_antisymm (leadOnes_le u o B) h
    have := leadOnes_ones u o B (B - 1) (by unfold tval at heq; omega)
    have h2 := hwf.2
    rw [show o + B - 1 = o + (B - 1) by omega] at h2
    exact absurd this h2

name: Complexity.Planar.FieldWF.ones_below
statement:
theorem FieldWF.ones_below {u : List Bool} {o B : Nat} (hwf : FieldWF u o B) (v : Nat)
    (hv : v < B) (h : u[o + v]? = some true) : ∀ i, i ≤ v → u[o + i]? = some true
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  induction h' : v - i generalizing i with
  | zero => have : i = v := by omega
            subst this; exact h
  | succ k ih =>
    have hnext := ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    have := hwf.1 i (by omega) hne
    rw [show o + i + 1 = o + (i + 1) by omega] at this
    exact this hnext

name: Complexity.Planar.selected_iff
statement:
theorem selected_iff {u : List Bool} {o B : Nat} (hwf : FieldWF u o B) (hB : 0 < B) (v : Nat)
    (hv : v < B) : Selected u o v ↔ v = tval u o B
proof:
:= by
  have hlt := tval_lt hwf hB
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨rfl, hno⟩ | ⟨hpos, hone, hno⟩)
    · symm
      apply leadOnes_eq u o B 0 (by omega) (by intro i hi; omega)
      intro _; simpa using hno
    · symm
      apply leadOnes_eq u o B v (by omega)
      · intro i hi
        have hone' : u[o + (v - 1)]? = some true := by
          rw [show o + (v - 1) = o + v - 1 by omega]; exact hone
        exact hwf.ones_below (v - 1) (by omega) hone' i (by omega)
      · intro _; exact hno
  · rintro rfl
    by_cases h0 : tval u o B = 0
    · left
      refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
      have := leadOnes_stop u o B hlt
      unfold tval at h0; rw [h0] at this; simpa using this
    · right
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_, leadOnes_stop u o B hlt⟩
      have := leadOnes_ones u o B (tval u o B - 1) (by unfold tval at h0 ⊢; omega)
      rwa [show o + (tval u o B - 1) = o + tval u o B - 1 by omega] at this

name: Complexity.Planar.fieldWF_of_ge
statement:
theorem fieldWF_of_ge {u : List Bool} {o B : Nat} (h : u.length ≤ o) (hB : 0 < B) :
    FieldWF u o B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro b _ _ hb
    simp [List.getElem?_eq_none (show u.length ≤ o + b + 1 by omega)] at hb
  · simp [NotOne, List.getElem?_eq_none (show u.length ≤ o + B - 1 by omega)]

name: Complexity.Planar.holds_selectAt
statement:
theorem holds_selectAt (u : List Bool) (o : Ex S) (s : Fin S) (body : Chk S)
    (ρ : Fin S → Nat) :
    Holds u (selectAt o s body) ρ ↔ (Selected u (o.eval ρ) (ρ s) → Holds u body ρ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [selectAt, Holds, Ex.eval, Selected, NotOne]
  by_cases h0 : ρ s ≤ 0
  · have : ρ s = 0 := by omega
    simp only [this]
    rcases hb : u[o.eval ρ]? with _ | _ | _ <;> simp
  · simp only [h0, ite_false]
    have hpos : 0 < ρ s := by omega
    have hne : ρ s ≠ 0 := by omega
    rcases hb : u[o.eval ρ + ρ s - 1]? with _ | _ | _
    · simp [hpos, hne]
    · simp [hpos, hne]
    · simp only
      rcases hb2 : u[o.eval ρ + ρ s]? with _ | _ | _ <;> simp [hpos, hne]

name: Complexity.Planar.Ex.fresh_slot
statement: @[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_slot (t s : Fin S) : (Ex.slot t).fresh s = (t != s)
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Ex.fresh_const
statement: @[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_const (c : Nat) (s : Fin S) : (Ex.const c : Ex S).fresh s = true
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Ex.fresh_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_add (a b : Ex S) (s : Fin S) :
    (Ex.add a b).fresh s = (a.fresh s && b.fresh s)
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Ex.fresh_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_mul (a b : Ex S) (s : Fin S) :
    (Ex.mul a b).fresh s = (a.fresh s && b.fresh s)
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Ex.fresh_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_sub (a b : Ex S) (s : Fin S) :
    (Ex.sub a b).fresh s = (a.fresh s && b.fresh s)
proof: := rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Ex.eval_setSlot_fresh
statement:
theorem Ex.eval_setSlot_fresh (e : Ex S) (s : Fin S) (v : Nat) (ρ : Fin S → Nat)
    (h : e.fresh s = true) : e.eval (setSlot ρ s v) = e.eval ρ
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | slot t =>
    simp only [Ex.fresh, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq] at h
    simp [Ex.eval, setSlot_other ρ h]
  | const c => rfl
  | add a b iha ihb =>
    simp only [Ex.fresh, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    simp [Ex.eval, iha h.1, ihb h.2]
  | mul a b iha ihb =>
    simp only [Ex.fresh, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    simp [Ex.eval, iha h.1, ihb h.2]
  | sub a b iha ihb =>
    simp only [Ex.fresh, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    simp [Ex.eval, iha h.1, ihb h.2]

name: Complexity.Planar.holds_readField
statement:
theorem holds_readField (u : List Bool) (o B : Ex S) (s : Fin S) (body : Chk S)
    (ρ : Fin S → Nat) (hfo : o.fresh s = true)
    (hwf : FieldWF u (o.eval ρ) (B.eval ρ)) (hB : 0 < B.eval ρ) :
    Holds u (readField o B s body) ρ ↔
      Holds u body (setSlot ρ s (tval u (o.eval ρ) (B.eval ρ)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [readField, holds_all, holds_selectAt, setSlot_same,
    Ex.eval_setSlot_fresh o s _ ρ hfo]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h _ (tval_lt hwf hB) ((selected_iff hwf hB _ (tval_lt hwf hB)).mpr rfl)
  · intro h i hi hsel
    rw [(selected_iff hwf hB i hi).mp hsel]
    exact h

name: Complexity.Planar.getElem?_flatten_offset
statement:
theorem getElem?_flatten_offset {α : Type} (ls : List (List α)) (j t : Nat)
    (hj : j < ls.length) (ht : t < ls[j].length) :
    ls.flatten[((ls.map List.length).take j).sum + t]? = ls[j][t]?
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing j with
  | nil => simp at hj
  | cons l ls ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero =>
      simp only [List.flatten_cons, List.take_zero, List.sum_nil, Nat.zero_add,
        List.getElem_cons_zero] at ht ⊢
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left ht]
    | succ j =>
      simp only [List.flatten_cons, List.map_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.sum_cons,
        List.getElem_cons_succ] at ht ⊢
      rw [show l.length + ((ls.map List.length).take j).sum + t =
        l.length + (((ls.map List.length).take j).sum + t) by omega,
        List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact ih j (by simpa using hj) ht

name: Complexity.Planar.length_flatten'
statement:
theorem length_flatten' {α : Type} (ls : List (List α)) :
    ls.flatten.length = (ls.map List.length).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l ls ih => simp [ih]

name: Complexity.Planar.incidenceGraph_eq
statement:
theorem incidenceGraph_eq (f : CNF) :
    incidenceGraph f = (f.zipIdx.map fun p => p.1.map fun l => (Sum.inl l.var, Sum.inr p.2)).flatten
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.incidenceGraph_length
statement:
theorem incidenceGraph_length (f : CNF) :
    (incidenceGraph f).length = (f.map List.length).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceGraph_eq, length_flatten']
  congr 1
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i h1 h2
    simp [List.getElem_zipIdx]

name: Complexity.Planar.incidenceGraph_getElem?
statement:
theorem incidenceGraph_getElem? (f : CNF) (j t : Nat) (hj : j < f.length)
    (ht : t < f[j].length) :
    (incidenceGraph f)[((f.map List.length).take j).sum + t]? =
      some (Sum.inl f[j][t].var, Sum.inr j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceGraph_eq]
  have hmap : ((f.zipIdx.map fun p => p.1.map fun l =>
      ((Sum.inl l.var, Sum.inr p.2) : Sum Nat Nat × Sum Nat Nat)).map List.length) =
      f.map List.length := by
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · simp
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp [List.getElem_zipIdx]
  have := getElem?_flatten_offset (f.zipIdx.map fun p => p.1.map fun l =>
      ((Sum.inl l.var, Sum.inr p.2) : Sum Nat Nat × Sum Nat Nat)) j t (by simpa using hj)
    (by simpa [List.getElem_zipIdx] using ht)
  rw [hmap] at this
  rw [this]
  simp [List.getElem_zipIdx, List.getElem?_eq_getElem ht]

name: Complexity.Planar.variableCycle_length
statement: theorem variableCycle_length (f : CNF) : (variableCycle f).length = variableCount f
proof:
:= by
  simp [variableCycle]

name: Complexity.Planar.variableCycle_getElem?
statement:
theorem variableCycle_getElem? (f : CNF) (i : Nat) (hi : i < variableCount f) :
    (variableCycle f)[i]? =
      some (Sum.inl i, Sum.inl (if i + 1 = variableCount f then 0 else i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [variableCycle, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range hi, Option.map_some]
  congr 3
  split
  · next h => rw [h]; simp
  · next h => exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

name: Complexity.Planar.foldr_eq_vmax
statement:
theorem foldr_eq_vmax (ls : List Literal) :
    ls.foldr (fun l n => Nat.max (l.var + 1) n) 0 = vmax ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l ls ih => simp [vmax, ih]

name: Complexity.Planar.le_vmax
statement: theorem le_vmax (ls : List Literal) : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.var + 1 ≤ vmax ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => simp
  | cons l ls ih =>
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih x hx) (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

name: Complexity.Planar.vmax_le
statement: theorem vmax_le (ls : List Literal) (K : Nat) (h : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.var < K) : vmax ls ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => simp [vmax]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    exact Nat.max_le.mpr ⟨h l List.mem_cons_self,
      ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem l hx))⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.vmax_attained
statement: theorem vmax_attained (ls : List Literal) : vmax ls = 0 ∨ ∃ l ∈ ls, l.var + 1 = vmax ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => simp [vmax]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    right
    rcases Nat.le_total (l.var + 1) (vmax ls) with h | h
    · rw [vmax, Nat.max_eq_right h]
      rcases ih with h0 | ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩
      · omega
      · exact ⟨x, List.mem_cons_of_mem l hx, hxe⟩
    · rw [vmax, Nat.max_eq_left h]
      exact ⟨l, List.mem_cons_self, rfl⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.variableCount_eq_vmax
statement: theorem variableCount_eq_vmax (f : CNF) : variableCount f = vmax f.flatten
proof:
:= by
  unfold variableCount; exact foldr_eq_vmax _

name: Complexity.Planar.variableCount_eq
statement:
theorem variableCount_eq (f : CNF) (K : Nat)
    (hlt : ∀ c ∈ f, ∀ l ∈ c, l.var < K)
    (hmax : K = 0 ∨ ∃ c ∈ f, ∃ l ∈ c, l.var + 1 = K) : variableCount f = K
proof:
:= by
  rw [variableCount_eq_vmax]
  have hle := vmax_le f.flatten K (fun l hl => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hlc⟩ := List.mem_flatten.mp hl; exact hlt c hc l hlc)
  rcases hmax with h0 | ⟨c, hc, l, hl, hlK⟩
  · omega
  · have := le_vmax f.flatten l (List.mem_flatten.mpr ⟨c, hc, hl⟩)
    omega

name: Complexity.Planar.variableCount_spec
statement:
theorem variableCount_spec (f : CNF) :
    (∀ c ∈ f, ∀ l ∈ c, l.var < variableCount f) ∧
      (variableCount f = 0 ∨ ∃ c ∈ f, ∃ l ∈ c, l.var + 1 = variableCount f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [variableCount_eq_vmax]
  refine ⟨fun c hc l hl => le_vmax f.flatten l (List.mem_flatten.mpr ⟨c, hc, hl⟩), ?_⟩
  rcases vmax_attained f.flatten with h | ⟨l, hl, hle⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hlc⟩ := List.mem_flatten.mp hl
    exact Or.inr ⟨c, hc, l, hlc, hle⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.halfEdgeEnd_append_left
statement:
theorem halfEdgeEnd_append_left {V : Type} (es es' : List (V × V)) (d : Nat)
    (hd : d < 2 * es.length) : halfEdgeEnd (es ++ es') d = halfEdgeEnd es d
proof:
:= by
  unfold halfEdgeEnd
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)]

name: Complexity.Planar.halfEdgeEnd_append_right
statement:
theorem halfEdgeEnd_append_right {V : Type} (es es' : List (V × V)) (d : Nat)
    (hd : 2 * es.length ≤ d) :
    halfEdgeEnd (es ++ es') d = halfEdgeEnd es' (d - 2 * es.length)
proof:
:= by
  unfold halfEdgeEnd
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
  have h1 : d / 2 - es.length = (d - 2 * es.length) / 2 := by omega
  have h2 : (d - 2 * es.length) % 2 = d % 2 := by omega
  rw [h1, h2]

name: Complexity.Planar.halfEdgeEnd_of_getElem?
statement:
theorem halfEdgeEnd_of_getElem? {V : Type} (es : List (V × V)) (e : Nat) (a b : V)
    (h : es[e]? = some (a, b)) :
    halfEdgeEnd es (2 * e) = some a ∧ halfEdgeEnd es (2 * e + 1) = some b
proof:
:= by
  unfold halfEdgeEnd
  have h1 : 2 * e / 2 = e := by omega
  have h2 : (2 * e + 1) / 2 = e := by omega
  have h3 : (2 * e + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  simp [h1, h2, h3, h, Nat.mul_mod_right]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.eval_off
statement:
theorem eval_off (τ : Nat) (idx : X) (ρ : Sl → Nat) :
    (off τ idx).eval ρ = 2 * ρ sL + 1 + (τ * tableSize (ρ sL) + idx.eval ρ) * fieldWidth (ρ sL)
proof:
:= by
  simp [off, base, Dx, Bx, k, E, Ex.eval, tableSize, fieldWidth]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.eval_Bx
statement: theorem eval_Bx (ρ : Sl → Nat) : Bx.eval ρ = fieldWidth (ρ sL)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Bx, k, E, Ex.eval, fieldWidth]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.holds_rd
statement:
theorem holds_rd {u : List Bool} {ρ : Sl → Nat} (hg : GlobalWF u (ρ sL))
    (τ : Nat) (idx : X) (dst : Sl) (body : C) (hf : (off τ idx).fresh dst = true) :
    Holds u (rd τ idx dst body) ρ ↔
      Holds u body (setSlot ρ dst (T u (ρ sL) τ (idx.eval ρ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hwf : FieldWF u ((off τ idx).eval ρ) (Bx.eval ρ) := by
    rw [eval_off, eval_Bx]
    exact hg _
  rw [rd, holds_readField u (off τ idx) Bx dst body ρ hf hwf (by rw [eval_Bx]; simp [fieldWidth]),
    eval_off, eval_Bx]
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.holds_reqX
statement:
theorem holds_reqX {u : List Bool} {ρ : Sl → Nat} (p : X) (v : Bool) :
    Holds u (reqX p v) ρ ↔ xbits u (ρ sL) (p.eval ρ) = some v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reqX, Holds, Ex.eval, E, k, xbits]
  by_cases hp : p.eval ρ + 1 ≤ ρ sL
  · simp only [hp, ite_true, show p.eval ρ < ρ sL by omega]
    rcases hb : u[ρ sL + 1 + p.eval ρ]? with _ | _ | _ <;> cases v <;> simp
  · simp only [hp, ite_false, show ¬ p.eval ρ < ρ sL by omega]
    simp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.Ex.fresh_hadd
statement: @[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_hadd (a b : X) (s : Sl) : (a + b).fresh s = (a.fresh s && b.fresh s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.Ex.fresh_hmul
statement: @[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_hmul (a b : X) (s : Sl) : (a * b).fresh s = (a.fresh s && b.fresh s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.Ex.fresh_hsub
statement: @[simp] theorem Ex.fresh_hsub (a b : X) (s : Sl) : (a - b).fresh s = (a.fresh s && b.fresh s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_Mle
statement: theorem s_Mle : Holds u cMle ρ ↔ (decodeCert u L).pt.m ≤ L
proof: := by simp [cMle]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_MMle
statement: theorem s_MMle : Holds u cMMle ρ ↔ (decodeCert u L).pt.M ≤ L
proof: := by simp [cMMle]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_head
statement:
theorem s_head : Holds u cHead ρ ↔
    ∀ i, i < (decodeCert u L).pt.m → xbits u L i = some true
proof: := by simp [cHead]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_headEnd
statement: theorem s_headEnd : Holds u cHeadEnd ρ ↔ xbits u L (decodeCert u L).pt.m = some false
proof:
:= by
  simp [cHeadEnd]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_O0
statement: theorem s_O0 : Holds u cO0 ρ ↔ (decodeCert u L).pt.O 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [cO0]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_Osucc
statement:
theorem s_Osucc : Holds u cOsucc ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.O (j + 1) = (decodeCert u L).pt.O j + (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j
proof:
:= by
  simp [cOsucc]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_Olast
statement:
theorem s_Olast : Holds u cOlast ρ ↔ (decodeCert u L).pt.O (decodeCert u L).pt.m =
    (decodeCert u L).pt.M
proof: := by simp [cOlast]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_P0
statement: theorem s_P0 : Holds u cP0 ρ ↔ (decodeCert u L).pt.P 0 = (decodeCert u L).pt.m + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cP0]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_len
statement:
theorem s_len : Holds u cLen ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m → ∀ i, i < (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j →
    xbits u L ((decodeCert u L).pt.P j + i) = some true
proof: := by simp [cLen]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_lenEnd
statement:
theorem s_lenEnd : Holds u cLenEnd ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m →
    xbits u L ((decodeCert u L).pt.P j + (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j) = some false
proof:
:= by
  simp [cLenEnd]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_empty
statement:
theorem s_empty : Holds u cEmpty ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j = 0 → (decodeCert u L).pt.P (j + 1) = (decodeCert u L).pt.P j + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cEmpty]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_first
statement:
theorem s_first : Holds u cFirst ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m → 0 < (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.Q ((decodeCert u L).pt.O j) =
      (decodeCert u L).pt.P j + (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cFirst]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_occ
statement:
theorem s_occ : Holds u cOcc ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.J e < (decodeCert u L).pt.m ∧
    (decodeCert u L).pt.T e < (decodeCert u L).pt.kk ((decodeCert u L).pt.J e) ∧
    (decodeCert u L).pt.O ((decodeCert u L).pt.J e) + (decodeCert u L).pt.T e = e
proof:
:= by
  simp [cOcc]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.not_imp_not_imp
statement: theorem not_imp_not_imp {a b c : Prop} : (¬a → ¬b → c) ↔ (a ∨ b ∨ c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ha : a
    · exact Or.inl ha
    · by_cases hb : b
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hb)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (h ha hb))
  · rintro (h | h | h) ha hb
    · exact absurd h ha
    · exact absurd h hb
    · exact h

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_sign
statement:
theorem s_sign : Holds u cSign ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.S e ≤ 1 ∧
      xbits u L ((decodeCert u L).pt.Q e) = some ((decodeCert u L).pt.S e == 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cSign]; vsimp
  apply forall_congr'; intro e; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
  by_cases h1 : T u L 8 e = 1
  · simp [h1]
  · have hb : (T u L 8 e == 1) = false := by simpa using h1
    simp [h1, hb]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_var
statement:
theorem s_var : Holds u cVar ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M → ∀ i, i < (decodeCert u L).pt.V e →
    xbits u L ((decodeCert u L).pt.Q e + 1 + i) = some true
proof: := by simp [cVar]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_varEnd
statement:
theorem s_varEnd : Holds u cVarEnd ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    xbits u L ((decodeCert u L).pt.Q e + 1 + (decodeCert u L).pt.V e) = some false
proof:
:= by
  simp [cVarEnd]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_next
statement:
theorem s_next : Holds u cNext ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.T e + 1 < (decodeCert u L).pt.kk ((decodeCert u L).pt.J e) →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.Q (e + 1) = (decodeCert u L).pt.Q e + (decodeCert u L).pt.V e + 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [cNext]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_last
statement:
theorem s_last : Holds u cLast ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.T e + 1 = (decodeCert u L).pt.kk ((decodeCert u L).pt.J e) →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.P ((decodeCert u L).pt.J e + 1) =
      (decodeCert u L).pt.Q e + (decodeCert u L).pt.V e + 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [cLast]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_Plast
statement: theorem s_Plast : Holds u cPlast ρ ↔ (decodeCert u L).pt.P (decodeCert u L).pt.m = L
proof:
:= by
  simp [cPlast]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_three
statement:
theorem s_three : Holds u cThree ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j ≤ 3
proof: := by simp [cThree]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_sat
statement:
theorem s_sat : Holds u cSat ρ ↔ ∀ j, j < (decodeCert u L).pt.m →
    (decodeCert u L).tsel j < (decodeCert u L).pt.kk j ∧
    ((decodeCert u L).A ((decodeCert u L).pt.V ((decodeCert u L).pt.O j + (decodeCert u L).tsel j)) = 1 ↔
      (decodeCert u L).pt.S ((decodeCert u L).pt.O j + (decodeCert u L).tsel j) = 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cSat]; vsimp
  apply forall_congr'; intro j; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
  apply and_congr_right; intro _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_varLt
statement:
theorem s_varLt : Holds u cVarLt ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).pt.V e < (decodeCert u L).K
proof: := by simp [cVarLt]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_varZero
statement: theorem s_varZero : Holds u cVarZero ρ ↔ ((decodeCert u L).pt.M = 0 → (decodeCert u L).K = 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cVarZero]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_varMax
statement:
theorem s_varMax : Holds u cVarMax ρ ↔ (0 < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).estar < (decodeCert u L).pt.M ∧
      (decodeCert u L).pt.V (decodeCert u L).estar + 1 = (decodeCert u L).K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cVarMax]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_n2
statement:
theorem s_n2 (cyc : Bool) : Holds u (cN2 cyc) ρ ↔
    (decodeCert u L).et.n2 = (decodeCert u L).pt.M + (if cyc then (decodeCert u L).K else 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases cyc <;> simp [cN2] <;> vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_endOcc
statement:
theorem s_endOcc : Holds u cEndOcc ρ ↔ ∀ e, e < (decodeCert u L).pt.M →
    (decodeCert u L).et.EN (2 * e) = 2 * (decodeCert u L).pt.V e ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.EN (2 * e + 1) = 2 * (decodeCert u L).pt.J e + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cEndOcc]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_endCyc
statement:
theorem s_endCyc (cyc : Bool) : Holds u (cEndCyc cyc) ρ ↔ (cyc = true → ∀ i, i < (decodeCert u L).K →
    (decodeCert u L).et.EN (2 * ((decodeCert u L).pt.M + i)) = 2 * i ∧
    (decodeCert u L).et.EN (2 * ((decodeCert u L).pt.M + i) + 1) =
      (if i + 1 = (decodeCert u L).K then 0 else 2 * (i + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  cases cyc
  · simp [cEndCyc]
  · simp only [cEndCyc]; vsimp
    apply forall_congr'; intro i; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
    apply and_congr_right; intro _
    by_cases h1 : i + 1 = T u L 0 2 <;> simp [h1]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_bound
statement:
theorem s_bound : Holds u cBound ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.N d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.F d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2
proof: := by simp [cBound]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_edgeK
statement:
theorem s_edgeK : Holds u cEdgeK ρ ↔ ∀ h, h < (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.N ((decodeCert u L).et.F (2 * h + 1)) = 2 * h ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.N ((decodeCert u L).et.F (2 * h)) = 2 * h + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cEdgeK]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_nodeEnd
statement:
theorem s_nodeEnd : Holds u cNodeEnd ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.EN ((decodeCert u L).et.N d) = (decodeCert u L).et.EN d
proof:
:= by
  simp [cNodeEnd]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_rankNext
statement:
theorem s_rankNext : Holds u cRankNext ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.R ((decodeCert u L).et.N d) = (decodeCert u L).et.R d + 1 ∨
      (decodeCert u L).et.R ((decodeCert u L).et.N d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [cRankNext]; vsimp
  apply forall_congr'; intro d; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
  by_cases h0 : T u L 14 (T u L 12 d) = 0 <;> simp [h0]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_rankLt
statement:
theorem s_rankLt : Holds u cRankLt ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.R d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2
proof: := by simp [cRankLt]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_rankPrev
statement:
theorem s_rankPrev : Holds u cRankPrev ρ ↔ ∀ h, h < (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (0 < (decodeCert u L).et.R (2 * h) →
      (decodeCert u L).et.R ((decodeCert u L).et.F (2 * h + 1)) + 1 = (decodeCert u L).et.R (2 * h)) ∧
    (0 < (decodeCert u L).et.R (2 * h + 1) →
      (decodeCert u L).et.R ((decodeCert u L).et.F (2 * h)) + 1 =
        (decodeCert u L).et.R (2 * h + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [cRankPrev]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_rankUnique
statement:
theorem s_rankUnique : Holds u cRankUnique ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    ∀ d', d' < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.EN d = (decodeCert u L).et.EN d' → (decodeCert u L).et.R d = 0 →
      (decodeCert u L).et.R d' = 0 → d = d'
proof:
:= by
  simp [cRankUnique]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_face
statement:
theorem s_face : Holds u cFace ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.FL d ≤ d ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.FL ((decodeCert u L).et.F d) = (decodeCert u L).et.FL d
proof:
:= by
  simp [cFace]; vsimp

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_comp
statement:
theorem s_comp : Holds u cComp ρ ↔ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (decodeCert u L).et.CL d ≤ d ∧
      ((decodeCert u L).et.D d = 0 ↔ (decodeCert u L).et.CL d = d)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cComp]; vsimp
  apply forall_congr'; intro d; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
  apply and_congr_right; intro _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_succ
statement:
theorem s_succ : Holds u cSucc ρ ↔ ∀ h, h < (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
    (0 < (decodeCert u L).et.D (2 * h) →
      (decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h) < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.D ((decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h)) + 1 = (decodeCert u L).et.D (2 * h) ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.CL ((decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h)) = (decodeCert u L).et.CL (2 * h) ∧
      ((decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h) = 2 * h + 1 ∨
        (decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h) = (decodeCert u L).et.N (2 * h) ∨
        (decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h) = (decodeCert u L).et.F (2 * h))) ∧
    (0 < (decodeCert u L).et.D (2 * h + 1) →
      (decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h + 1) < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.D ((decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h + 1)) + 1 =
        (decodeCert u L).et.D (2 * h + 1) ∧
      (decodeCert u L).et.CL ((decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h + 1)) =
        (decodeCert u L).et.CL (2 * h + 1) ∧
      ((decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h + 1) = 2 * h ∨
        (decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h + 1) = (decodeCert u L).et.N (2 * h + 1) ∨
        (decodeCert u L).et.SU (2 * h + 1) = (decodeCert u L).et.F (2 * h + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cSucc, succAt]; vsimp
  simp only [not_imp_not_imp]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_count
statement:
theorem s_count (τ σ : Nat) (self : Bool) : Holds u (cCount τ σ self) ρ ↔
    T u L τ 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ d, d < 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2 →
      T u L τ (d + 1) = T u L τ d + (if T u L σ d = (if self then d else 0) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases self
  · simp only [cCount]; vsimp
    intro _
    apply forall_congr'; intro d; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
    by_cases h0 : T u L σ d = 0 <;> simp [h0]
  · simp only [cCount]; vsimp
    intro _
    apply forall_congr'; intro d; apply imp_congr_right; intro _
    by_cases h0 : T u L σ d = d <;> simp [h0]

name: Complexity.Planar.Vf.s_final
statement:
theorem s_final : Holds u cFinal ρ ↔ 2 * (decodeCert u L).et.cC (2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2) +
    (decodeCert u L).et.n2 ≤ (decodeCert u L).et.cR (2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2) +
      (decodeCert u L).et.cF (2 * (decodeCert u L).et.n2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cFinal]; vsimp

name: Complexity.NTM.exec_expand
statement:
theorem exec_expand {k : Nat} (src dst : Fin (k + 1)) (hne : src ≠ dst) (xs : List Bool)
    (r : Registers k) (hr : r src = xs) :
    Exec (expand src dst) 0 r (3 * xs.length + 2)
      (true, set (set r src []) dst (symbols (xs.reverse.map Symbol.bit) ++ r dst))
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing r with
  | nil =>
    have heq : set (set r src []) dst (symbols (([] : List Bool).reverse.map Symbol.bit) ++ r dst) =
        set r src [] := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = dst
      · subst j; simp [Ne.symm hne, symbols]
      · simp [StackMachine.set, hj]
    rw [heq]
    exact .next (q' := 1) (r' := set r src [])
      (by simp [StackProgram.step, expand, hr, branch])
      (.halt (by simp [StackProgram.step, expand]))
  | cons b xs ih =>
    let r' := set (set r src xs) dst (high (.bit b) :: low (.bit b) :: r dst)
    have h := ih r' (by simp [r', hne])
    have hpop : StackProgram.step (expand src dst) 0 r =
        .inr ((if b then 4 else 2), set r src xs) := by
      cases b <;> simp [StackProgram.step, expand, hr, branch]
    have hlow : StackProgram.step (expand src dst) (if b then 4 else 2) (set r src xs) =
        .inr ((if b then 5 else 3), set (set r src xs) dst (low (.bit b) :: r dst)) := by
      cases b <;> simp [StackProgram.step, expand, low, Ne.symm hne]
    have hhigh : StackProgram.step (expand src dst) (if b then 5 else 3)
        (set (set r src xs) dst (low (.bit b) :: r dst)) = .inr (0, r') := by
      cases b <;> simp [StackProgram.step, expand, high, r', StackWords.set_overwrite]
    have hh := Exec.next hpop (Exec.next hlow (Exec.next hhigh h))
    have hout : set (set r' src []) dst (symbols (xs.reverse.map Symbol.bit) ++ r' dst) =
        set (set r src []) dst (symbols ((b :: xs).reverse.map Symbol.bit) ++ r dst) := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = dst
      · subst j
        simp [r', symbols, List.reverse_cons, List.map_append, TapeToStacks.symbols_append]
      · by_cases hs : j = src
        · subst j; simp [hj]
        · simp [r', StackMachine.set, hj, hs]
    rw [hout] at hh
    have htime : 3 * xs.length + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 * (b :: xs).length + 2 := by
      simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
    rw [htime] at hh
    exact hh

name: Complexity.NTM.Label.ofSum_toSum
statement:
@[simp] theorem Label.ofSum_toSum {M : NMachine} (q : Label M) :
    Label.ofSum q.toSum = q
proof: := by cases q <;> rfl

name: Complexity.NTM.exec_read
statement:
theorem exec_read (M : NMachine) {k : Nat} (ch lt rt : Fin (k + 1))
    (q : Fin (M.states + 1)) (side : Bool) (xs : List Symbol) (r : Registers k)
    (hr : r (sideRegister lt rt side) = symbols xs) (time : Nat) (result : Bool × Registers k)
    (h : Exec (core M ch lt rt) (.choose q (xs.headD .blank))
      (set r (sideRegister lt rt side) (symbols (xs.drop 1))) time result) :
    Exec (core M ch lt rt) (.read q side) r (time + readCost xs) result
proof:
:= by
  cases xs with
  | nil =>
    exact .next (by simp [StackProgram.step, core, hr, branch, symbols]) h
  | cons a rest =>
    have hs : StackProgram.step (core M ch lt rt) (.read q side) r =
        .inr (.readLow q side (high a),
          set r (sideRegister lt rt side) (low a :: symbols rest)) := by
      cases hhigh : high a <;> simp [StackProgram.step, core, symbols, branch, hr, hhigh]
    have ht : StackProgram.step (core M ch lt rt) (.readLow q side (high a))
        (set r (sideRegister lt rt side) (low a :: symbols rest)) =
        .inr (.choose q a, set r (sideRegister lt rt side) (symbols rest)) := by
      have hp := pairSymbol_bits a
      cases hlow : low a <;> simp_all [StackProgram.step, core, branch]
    exact .next hs (.next ht (by simpa [readCost] using h))

name: Complexity.NTM.branch_headD
statement:
theorem branch_headD {α : Type} (cs : List Bool) (f : Bool → α) :
    branch cs (f false) (f false) (f true) = f (cs.headD false)
proof:
:= by
  cases cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs => cases c <;> rfl

name: Complexity.NTM.core_simulates
statement:
theorem core_simulates (M : NMachine) {k : Nat} (ch lt rt : Fin (k + 1))
    (hcl : ch ≠ lt) (hcr : ch ≠ rt) (hlr : lt ≠ rt)
    (fuel : Nat) (cs : List Bool) (q : Fin (M.states + 1)) (t : Tape) (b : Bool) (out : Tape)
    (hrun : runD M fuel cs q t = some (b, out)) (r : Registers k)
    (hch : r ch = cs) (hlt : r lt = symbols t.left) (hrt : r rt = symbols (t.right.drop 1)) :
    ∃ time r', time ≤ 5 * fuel ∧
      Exec (core M ch lt rt) (.choose q t.read) r time (b, r')
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing cs q t r with
  | zero => simp [runD] at hrun
  | succ fuel ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hcd⟩ : ∃ c, cs.headD false = c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hrun' : (match M.code c q t.read with
        | .halt b => some (b, t)
        | .step a d q' => runD M fuel cs.tail q' ((t.write a).move d)) = some (b, out) := by
      rw [← hcd]; exact hrun
    let r₁ := set r ch cs.tail
    have hchoose : StackProgram.step (core M ch lt rt) (.choose q t.read) r =
        .inr (.exec c q t.read, r₁) := by
      simp only [StackProgram.step, core, hch, r₁]
      rw [branch_headD cs (fun c => Label.exec c q t.read), hcd]
    have hlt₁ : r₁ lt = symbols t.left := by simp [r₁, Ne.symm hcl, hlt]
    have hrt₁ : r₁ rt = symbols (t.right.drop 1) := by simp [r₁, Ne.symm hcr, hrt]
    have hch₁ : r₁ ch = cs.tail := by simp [r₁]
    cases hc : M.code c q t.read with
    | halt b' =>
      have heq : (b', t) = (b, out) := by simpa [hc] using hrun'
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq
      refine ⟨2, r₁, by omega, .next hchoose (.halt ?_)⟩
      simp [StackProgram.step, core, hc]
    | step a d q' =>
      have hnext : runD M fuel cs.tail q' ((t.write a).move d) = some (b, out) := by
        simpa [hc] using hrun'
      cases d with
      | stay =>
        obtain ⟨time, r', ht, he⟩ := ih cs.tail q' ((t.write a).move .stay) hnext r₁ hch₁
          (by simpa [Tape.move, Tape.write] using hlt₁)
          (by simpa [Tape.move, Tape.write] using hrt₁)
        have he' : Exec (core M ch lt rt) (.choose q' a) r₁ time (b, r') := by
          simpa [Tape.move, Tape.write, Tape.read] using he
        refine ⟨time + 1 + 1, r', by omega, .next hchoose (.next ?_ he')⟩
        simp [StackProgram.step, core, hc]
      | right =>
        let r₂ := set r₁ lt (low a :: r₁ lt)
        let r₃ := set r₂ lt (high a :: r₂ lt)
        have hlt₃ : r₃ lt = symbols (a :: t.left) := by simp [r₃, r₂, hlt₁, symbols]
        have hrt₃ : r₃ (sideRegister lt rt false) = symbols (t.right.drop 1) := by
          simp [r₃, r₂, sideRegister, Ne.symm hlr, hrt₁]
        have htape : (t.write a).move .right = ⟨a :: t.left, t.right.drop 1⟩ := by
